# The Diaspora App

> A premium discovery platform for diaspora-owned businesses worldwide — restaurants, salons, barbers, photographers, tailors, churches, car-lift drivers, and creative talent — across 47 cities and 23 countries. Editorial-grade listings with verified businesses, real customer reviews, and direct WhatsApp ordering.

The Diaspora App helps people from diaspora communities discover trusted businesses near them, and helps those businesses reach customers without paying transaction commissions. Listings are physically inspected before earning the blue Verified tick. The Premium gold badge is the highest trust tier, requiring verified status plus a paid subscription and quarterly re-inspection.

## Core platform pages

- [Home](https://www.thediaspora.app/): Premium directory landing with featured spotlights, On-the-Menu food rail, In-the-Chair beauty rail, and category browser.
- [Directory / search](https://www.thediaspora.app/feed.html): Filter every business by city, category, area, or keyword. Supports `?city=`, `?category=`, `?country=`, `?q=` query parameters.
- [Become a seller](https://www.thediaspora.app/become-seller.html): Five-field intake form for new business listings. Free forever; zero commission on transactions.
- [Trust & Verification](https://www.thediaspora.app/verification.html): Detailed criteria for the blue Verified tick and gold Premium badge — physical inspections, records check, quarterly re-inspections.
- [Pricing for sellers](https://www.thediaspora.app/pricing.html): Six premium placement tiers — Featured Spotlight, On the Menu, In the Chair, City Spotlight, WhatsApp Lead Ad, Hiring Campaign.

Restaurants · Home Cooks & Food Sellers · Caterers · Bakers & Pastries · Grocery & Specialty Foods · Butchers & Halal Meat · Hair Stylists · Barbers · Loc & Natural Hair · Beauty & Makeup · Nails · Spa & Wellness · Fitness Trainers · Photographers · Videographers · DJs & Music · Event Planners · Florists · Tailors & Fashion · Jewelers · Designers · Marketing & Social Media · Software & IT · Lawyers · Accountants & Tax · Doctors & Clinics · Therapists & Counseling · Tutors & Education · Childcare & Nannies · Cleaning Services · Movers · Real Estate · Bed Space & Partition (UAE) · Car Lift & Carpooling · Churches & Faith Communities · Mosques & Prayer Halls · Auto & Mechanics · Construction & Trades · Travel & Tour Operators · Pet Care · Jobs

## Cities currently served

Dubai · Abu Dhabi · Sharjah · London · Manchester · Toronto · Montreal · New York · Atlanta · Houston · Lagos · Abuja · Nairobi · Mombasa · Accra · Johannesburg · Cape Town · Paris · Berlin (more launching monthly).

## How ordering works

Customers pick items from a seller's menu (services, dishes, packages, sessions), choose a service mode (📍 Pickup / 🚚 Delivery / 🏠 Mobile/On-site), then continue to WhatsApp with the order pre-filled — including ref number, line items, total, and customer details. The seller sees the order in their dashboard and can mark it fulfilled. MOMO Pay (mobile money) and Botim (UAE-friendly chat) are coming soon as additional channels.

## Trust signals

- 🔵 Verified — physical site visit, trade-licence + records check, owner ID verification, public visit report.
- 🥇 Premium — Verified + paid subscription + quarterly re-inspection. Highest trust tier; priority placement and one free monthly Featured Spotlight.

Both badges are admin-issued only. Owners cannot self-apply.
